_comment: Comprehensive question catalog for SAP SQL agent training. Use for: few-shot examples, sql_catalog question_patterns, and LLM prompt enrichment.
_usage: 1. Add question_patterns to sql_catalog.json for exact matches
2. Use as few-shot examples in run_sap_sql_agent (get_sql_examples_for_question)
3. Include in _pick_tables_adaptive prompt for table selection
4. Validate coverage: ensure each category has working SQL

few_shot_examples.user_query: Total cost by profit center from FAGLFLEXA
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT fg.prctr AS profit_center, COALESCE(c.name1, fg.prctr) AS profit_center_name, SUM(fg.hsl) AS total_cost, fg.rtcur AS currency FROM FAGLFLEXA fg LEFT JOIN CEPC c ON fg.prctr = c.prctr WHERE fg.prctr IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fg.prctr) != '' GROUP BY fg.prctr, c.name1, fg.rtcur ORDER BY total_cost DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

few_shot_examples.user_query: Link FAGLFLEXA profit center costs back to major customers and products where possible
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT v.prctr AS profit_center, COALESCE(epc.name1, v.prctr) AS profit_center_name, c.name1 AS customer_name, vk.kunag AS customer_number, COALESCE(m.maktx, v.matnr) AS product_name, v.matnr AS material_number, f.total_cost AS profit_center_total_cost, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS revenue FROM vbrp v JOIN VBRK vk ON TRIM(v.vbeln) = TRIM(vk.vbeln) LEFT JOIN KNA1 c ON vk.kunag = c.kunnr LEFT JOIN MAKT m ON v.matnr = m.matnr AND (m.spras = 'E' OR m.spras IS NULL) LEFT JOIN CEPC epc ON v.prctr = epc.prctr LEFT JOIN (SELECT prctr, SUM(hsl) AS total_cost FROM FAGLFLEXA WHERE prctr IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(prctr) != '' GROUP BY prctr) f ON v.prctr = f.prctr WHERE v.prctr IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(v.prctr) != '' AND CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.prctr, epc.name1, vk.kunag, c.name1, v.matnr, m.maktx, f.total_cost ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
few_shot_examples.fallback_note: If 0 rows: return profit center costs only (FAGLFLEXA GROUP BY prctr)

few_shot_examples.user_query: Top 10 products by total purchase cost and quantity using EKPO
few_shot_examples.sql: SELECT e.matnr, SUM(e.netwr) AS total_cost, SUM(e.menge) AS total_quantity, e.meins FROM EKPO e WHERE e.netwr IS NOT NULL AND e.menge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.matnr, e.meins ORDER BY total_cost DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT vk.kunag AS customer_number, COALESCE(k.name1, vk.kunag) AS customer_name, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_revenue, vk.waerk AS currency FROM vbrp v JOIN VBRK vk ON TRIM(v.vbeln) = TRIM(vk.vbeln) LEFT JOIN KNA1 k ON vk.kunag = k.kunnr WHERE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vk.kunag, k.name1, vk.waerk ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
